name: Heart Failure Clinical Records: Survival Prediction Benchmark
description: The Heart Failure Clinical Records dataset from the UCI Machine Learning Repository (ID 519) is a biomedical prognostic benchmark curated from medical records of patients with heart failure seen at the Faisalabad Institute of Cardiology in Pakistan. Published in BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making, the dataset comprises 299 patient records with 12 clinical and biochemical features: age, anaemia, creatinine phosphokinase, diabetes, ejection fraction, high blood pressure, platelets, serum creatinine, serum sodium, sex, smoking, and follow-up period in days. The primary clinical prediction task is binary survival (death event during the follow-up period), providing a key baseline for clinical risk stratification and machine learning survival analysis.
